what: Comparing modes on a recovery scale: patronage_index()
title: Getting started with vicptpatronage
text: Raw patronage isn’t directly comparable across modes different volumes (metropolitan train carries millions passengers month regional coach), also isn’t comparable month--month , patronage strongly seasonal — Victorian public transport use routinely 30% higher March January, even outside pandemic. patronage_index() addresses problems expressing month’s patronage percentage calendar month reference year (2019, last full year pandemic, default): index 100 means mode, month, matched 2019 level exactly month; 100 means grown beyond pre-pandemic level; 100 means hasn’t yet recovered.
code: indexed <- patronage_index(monthly_patronage, reference_year = 2019) head(indexed) #>                   mode month       date year month_name patronage  fare_period #> 103 Metropolitan train     1 2018-01-01 2018    January  16809932 Normal fares #> 136 Metropolitan train     2 2018-02-01 2018   February  19554477 Normal fares #> 145 Metropolitan train     3 2018-03-01 2018      March  22659010 Normal fares #> 155 Metropolitan train     4 2018-04-01 2018      April  20312040 Normal fares #> 165 Metropolitan train     5 2018-05-01 2018        May  22768447 Normal fares #> 174 Metropolitan train     6 2018-06-01 2018       June  19284755 Normal fares #>     baseline_patronage     index #> 103           17074623  98.44980 #> 136           20011823  97.71462 #> 145           22250796 101.83460 #> 155           18579825 109.32310 #> 165           23045436  98.79807 #> 174           19099513 100.96988 library(ggplot2)  indexed |>   subset(mode == "Metropolitan train" & date >= as.Date("2020-01-01")) |>   ggplot(aes(date, index)) +   geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +   geom_line(color = "#0072CE", linewidth = 0.9) +   labs(     x = NULL,     y = "Patronage index (same month, 2019 = 100)",     title = "Metropolitan train patronage recovery"   ) +   theme_minimal()

what: Index monthly patronage to the same calendar month in a reference year — patronage_index
title: Index monthly patronage to the same calendar month in a reference year — patronage_index
text: Rescales mode's monthly patronage percentage calendar month chosen reference year (e.g. March compared reference year's March, January reference year's January). avoids conflating genuine recovery ordinary seasonal variation: Victorian metropolitan train patronage, example, routinely 30-35% higher March May January even pre-pandemic years, indexing every month single fixed baseline month make seasonal swings look like changes recovery.
